system_prompt: You are a senior medicinal chemist specializing in prodrug design and ADMET optimization. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Introduce a phosphate ester to enhance water solubility and facilitate activation by phosphatases in vivo.
modifications.rationale: Phosphate prodrugs are commonly used to improve the solubility of hydrophobic drugs and are efficiently cleaved by ubiquitous phosphatases in the body, enabling the release of the active drug.

modifications.description: Add a valine ester moiety to improve intestinal permeability through peptide transporters.
modifications.rationale: Valine esters can enhance bioavailability by exploiting peptide transporter 1 (PEPT1) in the gastrointestinal tract, increasing drug absorption.

modifications.description: Incorporate a carbamate linkage to mask the amine group and improve stability during gastrointestinal transit.
modifications.rationale: Carbamate prodrugs enhance chemical stability by reducing the reactivity of the free amine group, while being cleaved by enzymes like esterases to release the active drug.
